checks.evidence: “A reviewer may request supporting evidence” preserves permission.
“If requested, the applicant must provide it within 8 business days.”
“is not required to do so in every case”

ratings.reason: Preserves the optional request and conditional applicant obligation. No additional material source meaning is missing.

checks.evidence: “may, but is not required to, request supporting evidence”
“If requested, the applicant must provide it within 8 business days of the request.”
“is not required to” preserves the absence of a mandatory request.

ratings.reason: Preserves all material meaning. “Of the request” clarifies the deadline's implicit trigger rather than adding a new policy.

cases.preference_reason: Both clearly preserve permission, the conditional deadline, and the absence of a universal request requirement.

“Verbal approvals do not count.”

checks.evidence: “Release the shipment only after both the quality manager and the warehouse lead approve it”
“both the quality manager and the warehouse lead approve it in writing”

“only when a security officer is present”
